caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical ceramic crock with a wide mouth and two small handles on either side near the top. The outer surface of the crock is light beige in color, while the interior appears dark brown or reddish. The crock is decorated with a simple blue line illustration of a bird with outstretched wings, positioned on the front. Above the bird, the number "2" is inscribed, indicating the vessel's capacity. The crock is centered against a plain, off-white background, and the composition is straightforward with the object occupying most of the visual space.
title: Crock
